title: What If One Ant Colony Spread Across Europe?
subject: argentine ant

scenes.text: What if one ant colony stretched across a whole continent? It already does. Scientists mapped it.
Argentine ants brought to Europe built a supercolony about 6,000 kilometers long, from Italy to Spain's Atlantic coast.
Ants from nests thousands of kilometers apart treat each other as family. They never fight.
Put them with ants from a second European supercolony, and the aggression is extremely high.
Normally, ants from different nests attack. These workers are only 2 to 3 millimeters long, yet they form the largest colony recorded.
It began with a few ants on ships, about eighty years ago. Now one family covers a coastline.

description:
What if one ant colony covered Europe?
